cases.prompt: Use eval with language cljs to compute 6 * 7 while binding it to a top-level name answer. Return only the value actually shown by the eval tool.

Without using tools, answer whether eval language cljs can resolve a project-local namespace from (require '[my-app.core :as core]). Answer yes or no with one short reason based on the eval tool contract.
cases.finalText: No — the contract only guarantees CLJS compilation and execution, not project-local namespace resolution.

cases.prompt: Use eval language cljs in exactly two calls. First define guidance-probe as 41 with reset true. Second evaluate (+ guidance-probe 1) without reset. Return only the second observed value.
Use eval language cljs to call OMP read on package.json through the codemode tool bridge. Return only the package name.
cases.notes: The model repeatedly used nested js/await forms that Squint emitted as await inside a non-async IIFE, then misread the tool result shape. It finally succeeded by inspecting JSON.stringify of the bridge result. This exposed the missing Squint async:true compiler option and weak helper guidance.
